## Change

Describe the concrete problem and resulting user-visible behavior.

## Validation

List commands actually run, results, and any limitations. Include relevant phone/desktop, reconnect, queue, or restart coverage.

## Operations

State any configuration, state-format, or idle daemon restart requirements.

## Checklist

- [ ] I read AGENTS.md and the relevant installed Next.js documentation.
- [ ] I ran pnpm verify, or explained why it could not run.
- [ ] I updated applicable documentation and preserved third-party notices.
- [ ] The diff contains only source and synthetic evidence, with no private runtime data.
